title: Preserve exact production preparation in a recovery PR
problem: Prerequisites are accepted and published, but mixed local preparation blocks protected Go and the clean primary-checkout scope-amendment runner. Existing broker operations cannot evacuate this state.
desired_effect: Execute the disclosed operator recovery playbook: preserve only the exact hash-pinned preparation as one commit on codex/preserve-production-preparation-20261002, publish only that branch and open its draft recovery PR. Keep main ref/history and every failed receipt unchanged; leave the checkout on the preserved recovery branch.

does: Validate exact published main a5a6844e751a6441576871b8b20ae8ccf2ab9d6e, origin, complete dirty-path/status and byte manifest, no unrelated staging, and this immutable local recovery transaction
Perform documented operator-owned branch creation and exact-file staging/commit; expose these Git effects explicitly rather than calling them protected broker custody

Use the semantic agent author identity, publish only the exact recovery snapshot with a normal non-force branch push and create/reuse its exact draft PR within four minutes plus at most twenty seconds of timeout cleanup

Retain original and refreshed Asks, AGENTS/Notes/friction lessons, derived readiness and scope design, the succeeded publication-only pair, this recovery pair and all prior run history; return the exact commit/PR receipt
never_does: Settle or approve an Ask, answer a Decision, complete an Action, change PROJECT/Plan/queue/policy, claim a broker reservation/Session/admission or silently rebind an immutable packet
Push main, merge, force-push, fetch/reconcile, reset, rebase, switch back to main, delete files/branches/worktrees, broaden staging to unknown paths, clear one-shot state or revive a Grant
Install or restart services, create the disposable live repository, activate production, launch an agent/reviewer/QA process or claim rehearsal success

success.effect: Exact preparation is recoverable in one published recovery commit and its draft PR; primary checkout is clean on that recovery branch, main ref is unchanged, governance and production authority are untouched.
success.next: Continue this recovery session to attach/validate the exact PR, report the known five unrelated library-check failures and run the review loop when ready. AGENTS guidance changes require operator merge review. After reviewed integration, use protected continuation; separately approve the three-record scope, create rehearsal and make-next. Never close the old literal proof by implication.

failure.effect: Precondition drift refuses. An interrupted local commit or publication retains the branch/index/input manifest/transaction and named failure; it never claims launch or partial progress as completion.
failure.next: Inspect this exact timestamped receipt and transaction. Retry only the same pinned request after resolving the named condition; never reset, stage unrelated work, remove a live lock, repeat acceptance or fabricate a broker binding.

preparationRecovery.prBody:
The enrollment/saved-configuration prerequisite settlement is already accepted and published. This recovery PR preserves the exact reviewed local operator-retry preparation, scope input drafts and learning documents that otherwise block clean-checkout continuation. It completes no governed Action and leaves the older literal split/browser/ledger proof open.

The proposed scope uses three actual implementation records: unchanged saved configuration, existing enrollment identity extended with durable execution, and installed-host rehearsal. The finite design reuses GitHub PR review/QA instead of a local reviewer supervisor. Both v2 Asks are validated but optional workspace previews were write-blocked; no scope acceptance, packet rebinding, pointer move or production activation is claimed.

Operator QA: inspect the pinned custody manifest and confirm the snapshot contains only the named files; verify PROJECT.md, the active Plan, main ref and production authority are unchanged. Review the updated AGENTS Orientation and Notes/friction report. Check the disposable-plan IDs and preserved prerequisite criteria in the v2 inputs.

Validation: publication recovery passed 19 hermetic cases and independent exact-hash review. Notes validation passed in its source task. The full operator library has five pre-existing unrelated UNDECLARED_OPERATOR_SETTLEMENT failures; this is an unresolved baseline, not a green-library claim. The recovery action must pass its focused custody/replay/refusal harness and direct shared contract before launch.

Integration and the three-record scope still require their exact review/authority gates; this draft is a preservation artifact, not readiness or autonomous rehearsal proof.
